content.title: Review holdings and inspect securities
content.description: An investment professional reviews the top holdings table with asset, pricing, position, weight, and P&L context, opens a preview popover from a ticker without reflowing the page, and drills into an in-page security modal for deeper pricing, fundamentals, analyst consensus, and news details.
content.summary: Inspect holdings and open detailed security views
content.value: Connects portfolio positions to security-level context without leaving the dashboard.
criteria: The top-holdings list contains AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, META, JPM, and XOM.
Holdings columns are ASSET, PRICE, DAY, POSITION, WEIGHT, and P&L.
A security preview popover opens on hover or explicit ticker activation and shows ticker, company name, price, daily move, Market Cap, P/E, 52W range, and OPEN SECURITY.
The preview popover must not cause page reflow.
The security modal shows security name, ticker, price, daily move, chart, fundamentals, analyst consensus, and recent news.
The security modal closes by Escape, close button, or backdrop click, and clicking inside the modal body does not close it.
